unknown_model.title: Receiver type not described yet
unknown_model.description:
The {model} is not a Denon or Marantz AV receiver from 2010 on, or it reports an interface version this integration does not know yet. Setup goes ahead; some settings may be missing or read wrongly.

The receiver test runs once the receiver is connected: it checks capabilities and tests commands quietly. Its results go into the diagnostics file, which you can attach to a prefilled issue on GitHub. Nothing is sent by itself.

data_description.test: Reads, then changes settings for a moment and puts them back. What you hear and see can be tested later in the options.

move_offer.title: Take over from another integration?
move_offer.description: {model} is already set up in {integration} as "{title}". Denon AVR Plus can take it over: that entry is disabled (it stays and can be enabled again), and its entities move here with their entity IDs, names, areas and history, so automations and dashboards keep working. Anything they use that works differently here is listed in a repair afterwards. The move can be undone in the options.

menu_option_descriptions.move_yes: Disable the old entry and take its entities over
menu_option_descriptions.move_no: Leave the old entry alone. Both connected at once disturb each other; a repair offers the move later

tests_start.title: Test the receiver
tests_start.description:
Three steps, about six minutes. Everything that changes is put back.

1. **Read capabilities**: only reads, about 1.5 minutes.
2. **Test quietly**: tone, picture, timers and the display change for a moment. About 4 minutes.
3. **Test what you hear and see**: asked before it starts.

A main zone that is off is turned on for the test and off again afterwards. Closing the window stops the test and puts everything back.

tests_ask.title: Step 3 of 3
tests_ask.description:
**Test what you hear and see?**

Mute, speakers, HDMI output, tuner, Zone 2 and the setup menu on the TV change for a moment and are put back. Stay in front of the TV; it takes about two minutes.

tests_done.title: Everything put back

telnet_unavailable.title: {model} does not accept a control connection
telnet_unavailable.description:
The {model} answers on the network, but has not accepted a telnet connection on port 23 for several minutes. Until it does, the media players work over the web interface only: power, volume, mute and source, with up to 10 seconds delay. All other settings are unavailable.

The receiver allows only one telnet connection at a time. Common causes:

- Another integration or program holds that connection, for example the official Denon AVR integration or another home automation system. Remove or disable it for this receiver.
- The Denon or Marantz AVR Remote app while its tuner screen is open. Close that screen or the app.
- A firewall or VLAN rule blocks port 23 between Home Assistant and the receiver, while the web ports are open.

The message disappears by itself as soon as the connection works again.

capability_report.title: Help support the {model}
capability_report.description: The receiver test of the {model} has finished; its results are in the diagnostics file (Settings → Devices & services → Denon AVR Plus → ⋮ → Download diagnostics). Open the prefilled issue with "Learn more" and attach the file there. Ignore this message if you do not want to share it. What you hear and see can be tested under Configure → Test the receiver.

heos_playback_error.title: {model} could not play it
heos_playback_error.description:
HEOS on the {model} reported a playback error: {error}

Common causes are an address the receiver cannot reach, a format it does not play, or a service that needs a sign-in in the HEOS app. The message disappears by itself as soon as something plays again.

command_test_done.title: Command test of the {model} finished
command_test_done.description: The {model} confirmed {confirmed} of {total} commands. Settings not put back: {not_restored}; check them on the receiver if this is not 0. The details are in the diagnostics file (Settings → Devices & services → Denon AVR Plus → ⋮ → Download diagnostics). Open the prefilled issue with "Learn more" and attach the file there. Ignore this message if you do not want to share it.

confirm.title: Take over the receiver
confirm.description: Both integrations connect to the receiver, which takes one connection: they disturb each other. The {integration} entry "{title}" is disabled (it stays and can be enabled again), and its entities move to Denon AVR Plus with their entity IDs, names, areas and history. The move can be undone in the options.

abort.move_not_possible: The move is not possible right now: one of the two entries is not loaded.

move_check.title: Check automations after the move from {title}

confirm.title: Automations checked?

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Sends a raw telnet command to the receiver, for settings without an entity. Asked for a response, returns the receiver's replies.

command.name: Command
command.description: As in the protocol documents, for example PSDYNEQ ON or MV?. Printable ASCII, at most {max_length} characters.

store_tuner_preset.name: Store tuner preset
store_tuner_preset.description: Stores the station the tuner plays as a preset of the receiver. The tuner must be the source of a zone that is on.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: 1 to 56 (on older receivers A1 to G8, counted the same way).

volume_ramp.name: Volume ramp
volume_ramp.description: Moves the volume to a level over a number of seconds, in the receiver's steps. A new ramp, a volume command or switching the zone off stops it.

volume_level.name: Volume
volume_level.description: The level to end at, from 0 to 1, as for media_player.volume_set.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds the ramp takes; 0 sets the volume at once.

snapshot.name: Snapshot
snapshot.description: Keeps what the zone does now: power, input, volume and mute. The sound mode follows the input.

restore.name: Restore
restore.description: Puts the zone back as the last snapshot found it.

get_queue.name: Get queue
get_queue.description: The HEOS queue of the receiver: queue id, title, artist, album and image of each item (the first 100).

remove_from_queue.name: Remove from queue
remove_from_queue.description: Removes items from the HEOS queue.

queue_ids.name: Queue ids
queue_ids.description: The queue ids of the items, as get_queue lists them.

move_queue_item.name: Move queue items
move_queue_item.description: Moves items of the HEOS queue to another place.
